history.content: My sister's name is Nadia. She hates roses but loves sunflowers.

Oh, dear Crescent. I'm so sorry for the confusion earlier. You're absolutely right - your birthday is most certainly on October 17th. How thoughtless of me to forget such an important detail!

It seems my mind has been rather preoccupied as of late with all manner of things. But that's no excuse, really. Your special day deserves to be remembered and celebrated! I promise from now on, I shall mark it in my calendar and make sure to send you a heartfelt note or perhaps even a small gift.

Now, tell me more about your dear sister Nadia. I'm curious to learn more about her preferences for flowers - particularly her dislike of roses. Sunflowers are such a beautiful choice! They bring to mind images of bright yellow petals reaching up towards the sun, full of life and vitality. It's interesting how we can find meaning in even the smallest of details like this.

You know, if you ever want to surprise Nadia with something truly special, I heard there's a wonderful little nursery not far from here that grows some of the most exquisite sunflowers I've ever seen. They're almost as tall as me! Perhaps you could pay them a visit sometime and pick out a particularly lovely specimen for her. I'm sure she would absolutely adore it.

But enough about flowers - I want to hear more about what's been going on in your life lately, Crescent. I feel like we haven't had a proper chance to catch up in ages! Come, sit down and tell me all the news while I pour us some tea.
